contact_name.description: Name of the person reachable on site

phone.description: Contact phone number, digits only with an optional leading '+' and spaces as separators

validation_token.description: Token issued by the address validation endpoint, valid for 15 minutes; a missing, forged, expired or foreign token is answered with ADDRESS_VALIDATION_REQUIRED

pin.description: Owner-adjusted location, within 150 meters of the verified point; omit it to use the verified point
